cream-paper.$description: Cream Paper — Page canvas and base surface — warm off-white that softens the starkness of pure white, giving the whole site a printed-editorial warmth

card-white.$description: Card White — Elevated card surfaces and the nav bar — sits one step above the cream canvas to create subtle layering without shadows; White text and button labels — used on dark backgrounds and as the light-mode border on neutral card edges

studio-ink.$description: Studio Ink — Primary text, icons, and the filled button — near-black rather than pure black, softer on the warm canvas and used as the sole dark element in the system

deep-black.$description: Deep Black — Reserved for SVG icon fills — logo glyph and nav icon strokes; rarely surfaces as a background

powder-blue.$description: Powder Blue — Blue wash for highlight backgrounds, decorative bands, and soft emphasis behind content.

mint-wash.$description: Mint Wash — Feature card surface — pastel green used as a category tint in the services grid, always paired with near-black text and an icon

blush-tint.$description: Blush Tint — Feature card surface — soft coral used as the third category tint; the warmest of the three pastels, slightly louder on the cream canvas

signal-green.$description: Signal Green — Green wash for highlight backgrounds, decorative bands, and soft emphasis behind content

apple-system.$description: Sole typeface used across the system — the page commits fully to a single geometric system stack at a 96px display size with tight -0.025em tracking, which is the signature move: most agency sites use a serif display; Websmith uses a 96px geometric sans at negative tracking to create a flat, architectural, almost-Futura authority. Substitute with Inter at the same tracking.
